claim: Patchline ships a cross-paradigm transfer to event-sourcing and CRDT state transitions with held-out tests. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the CRDT claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make event-sourcing-crdt-transfer-gate`.
